notes.title: Update - Paratroopers Raid v2.1

tags.feature: new unlockable upgrades were added for projectile ricochet with the minigun and the fire cannon, and for triple shots with the fire cannon;
the Arcade and Long-Run modes now deliver your upgrades and special items in a random generated way, making every match a different experience;

tags.balance_change: the parameters over the enemies and the player's weapons have been updated to make the game difficulty more balanced;

notes.title: BIG Update - Paratroopers Raid v2.0

tags.feature: - "Roguelike" mode: new gameplay mode, more challenging, with upgrades chosen randomly and achieved by hitting a score goal. Your score is also ranked and can be shown in the game's Steam community;

- "Long-run" mode: new gameplay mode, with the same mechanics as the common "Arcade", but saving your progress whenever you want to leave the game, and then returning from the point you left, your progress will be syncronized with Steam Cloud;

- Selectable difficulties: in case the game's normal pace is too slow or too quick for you, try the diferent difficulties ("Easy", "Normal", "Medium" and "Hard") for the "Arcade" and "Long-run" gameplay modes;
- Configuration system: your audio, video and language configurations are now been saved and stored on Steam Cloud;
- New Leaderboard table: the ranking screen at the Main Menu now has the tables for 2 gameplay modes ("Arcade" and "Roguelike");
- Graphic interface upgrade: the panels of the UI were remade with a better resolution;

tags.bug: - Planes: the collision boards for the planes have been updated for a better coherence with theis sprites;

notes.title: Update - Paratroopers Raid v1.3

tags.feature: - 41 new achivments were added to the game, with challenges of survival and weapon mastery;

tags.bug: - a few messages for received upgrades were corrected;

notes.title: Update - Paratroopers Raid - v 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]New contents:[/h1]
[list]
[h2]- Special Itens:[/h2] Every 11 survived waves, the player receives a special item of single use, to help him in a moment of need. The inventory has 2 itens: the "Sky Cleaner" drone and the "Laser Overcharge" modification;

[h2]- Tutorial Screen:[/h2] More cards were added to the tutorial screen at the "Play" section of the main menu, now with all basic concepts of controls, enemies and itens received by the player;
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments:[/h1]
[list]
[h2]- Dynamic difficulty:[/h2] Now your match's difficulty depends on your skill levels, the longer it takes for you to be damaged, the harder the game will be;

[h2]- Upgrade Icon:[/h2] The icon for the upgrade box has been update for a better understanding;
[/list]

[h1]Patches:[/h1]
[list]
[h3]- Airplane sound;[/h3]
[h3]- Upgrade message control;[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Paratroopers Raid - v 1.1

tags.feature: Linked to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com//stats/3127690/leaderboards/14301572]Leaderboard Steam[/url], feature shows players with scores close to the player;
Shows the player’s basic controls with animated cards, and information of enemy soldiers;
It is now possible to save your current score as soon as you leave, either by closing the match, restarting or closing the game via the pause menu;
Now, the color of the life bar follows the health status of the player, becoming red when it falls below 40% health;
The table in the upper left corner, containing the points, number of waves and remaining enemies, now has a slight transparency, allowing for a more comfortable view of the game;
